description: This Java class 'KeyManagerFactoryFactory' is a factory implementation that creates javax.net.ssl.KeyManagerFactory instances for handling SSL client authentication. It processes PEM-formatted client keys and certificates, converts them into Java security objects, and configures key stores necessary for SSL connections.

classes.name: KeyManagerFactoryFactory
classes.description: A factory class that creates configured SSL KeyManagerFactory instances based on provided PEM-formatted client credentials. Implements CredentialsVisitor to process client certificate credentials.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates a singleton instance of KeyManagerFactoryFactory with empty headers.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of KeyManagerFactoryFactory with specified DittoHeaders.

methods.name: newKeyManagerFactory
methods.description: Generates a KeyManagerFactory initialized with the given PEM-formatted private key and certificate.

methods.name: getClientPrivateKey
methods.description: Extracts and constructs a PrivateKey object from PEM-encoded private key string.

methods.name: getClientCertificate
methods.description: Creates an X.509 Certificate object from PEM-encoded certificate string.

methods.name: clientCertificate
methods.description: Implements CredentialsVisitor to create a KeyManagerFactory from ClientCertificateCredentials.
